ObjectName: Grutte Pier (Pier Gerlofs Donia), 1622, book illustration
ImageDescription: Image from a 1622, non-copyrighted historical book. It shows en:Pier Gerlofs Donia, or en:Grutte Pier, a en:Frisian en:freedom fighter, en:rebel and en:folk hero. It was made over a hundred years after the man depicted in it died, so on its historical accuracy there might be some discussion (although it may be an accurate painting of the man, he isn't wearing 16th-century clothes, but is dressed in 17th-century clothing).
Credit: Pierius Winsemius, Chronique ofte Historische geschiedenisse van Vrieslant, 1622 Collectie Fries Museum
Artist: Pieter Feddes van Harlingen
